cards.title: Human Connection Matters More Than AI for Kids
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection is the biggest threat to children's development, not technology itself. The solution is spending more time talking openly with kids rather than worrying about screens.

cards.title: Teaching Children to Spot AI-Generated Content
cards.body: New research with 8- and 9-year-olds reveals how to help kids question what they see online. Practical tips can teach children to identify AI-generated videos and media.

cards.title: Early Helplessness Is Key to Human Development
cards.body: Unlike baby giraffes that walk within hours, human newborns are remarkably helpless at birth. Neuroscience suggests this extended dependency period is actually the secret to human intelligence and development.

cards.title: Adult Children's Independence Isn't Personal Rejection
cards.body: Parents who mistake their adult children's independence for rejection risk creating estrangement. Replacing judgment with curiosity is the key to maintaining meaningful family connections.

cards.title: When Parents Deny Your Childhood Abuse Experiences
cards.body: Having a parent deny one's childhood abuse experiences creates profound pain and complicates healing. Recognizing this denial is an important step in processing trauma.
